free_text_notes.physician_note: 66-year-old man with atrial fibrillation, CKD stage 3, admitted 3/22 with HFpEF exacerbation precipitated by dietary sodium excess. Diuresed 6 kg with IV furosemide; now euvolemic on oral regimen. The patient's ejection fraction was rechecked on day 3 and found to be slightly improved from the admission value. This is a positive finding and does not change the discharge plan.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Vitals stable this shift. Tolerating diet. 3/25 08:00: CVS reports empagliflozin needs prior authorization; claim rejected, patient cannot pick it up today. PT recommends assistance with all transfers for now. A low-grade temperature of 37.6 degrees was recorded on day 1. It resolved by day 2 without any treatment and has not returned.
